text:
Weeping, I enraged this fertile crystal river; singing calmed its course: so much can grief do in one absent!


I saw myself in the fountain before cold ice seized it, and saw my face deserves your burning light.


I left its waters rich with spoils; Isbela, it covered your altars with incense and grain.


I dried and swelled Henares with water and fire; in one stream I saw two seas in my eyes.

translation.title: Weeping, I Enraged the Current
